About
Medical doctor and independent public health researcher with over a decade of experience working at the intersection of sexual and reproductive health, gender equity, and mental health across conflict-affected communities in Southeast Asia and Africa. A Chin researcher from Falam, Myanmar, he brings together rigorous qualitative methods and deep programme experience to bridge the gap between research evidence and real-world action.
